page_content: Large concrete chunks are falling from the balcony of the old building onto the busy sidewalk near the main market; it almost hit a shopper.
A boundary wall of the municipal school near the metro pillar is leaning dangerously and looks like it will collapse on the children's path.
Unauthorized heavy construction on the terrace of an old apartment in Block B is causing visible, wide cracks in the ground floor pillars.
The structural beams of the public library are showing deep fissures and we can hear cracking sounds whenever there is heavy traffic outside.
The base of the flyover ramp near the civil hospital is eroding rapidly, and the retaining wall is bulging outwards dangerously.
A mobile tower has been installed illegally on a dilapidated roof near the school; the whole structure is swaying in the wind.
Deep excavation for a new mall near the rickshaw stand has caused the neighboring house's foundation to sink; the family is trapped inside.
Concrete slabs are falling from the ceiling of the railway underpass; one biker was seriously injured this morning.
An old heritage structure near the temple has partially collapsed into the narrow lane, blocking the only emergency exit for the residents.
Illegal commercial floor addition is being done using heavy machinery on a building that already has 'Dangerous' notice posted.
The fire escape staircase of the cinema hall is completely rusted and has detached from the main wall at the top floor.
A massive sinkhole has appeared inside the compound of the government colony due to poorly planned underground parking work.
The structural columns of the overhead water tank near the park are flaking off, exposing rusted iron rods that are snapping.
Scaffolding of the under-construction high-rise near the bypass has collapsed onto the main road; workers are stuck under the iron pipes.
A huge glass panel from the new IT park facade has shattered and fallen onto the bus stop below; total chaos at the scene.
The balcony of a house in the old city area is hanging by a thread and is directly above the main vegetable market entrance.
Illegal basement digging is happening right next to the metro station foundation; the ground is starting to vibrate and sink.
Large cracks have appeared in the wall of the hospital's ICU wing following the construction work in the adjacent plot.
The ceiling of the public waiting hall at the court complex has started sagging and plaster is falling in large chunks.
The parapet wall of the bridge over the nallah has completely broken off, leaving a 15-foot drop for any pedestrian who trips.
A construction crane at the site behind the mall has tilted and the counterweights are about to fall onto the nearby slums.
A portion of the facade of the multi-level parking has collapsed, damaging three cars and trapping one person in the lobby.
Foundations of the community center are flooded with sewage, and the walls are showing signs of structural failure and dampness.
An unauthorized billboard has been fixed to a weak electric pole; the pole is now bending and about to snap on the main road.
The outer staircase of the public dispensary has collapsed; elderly patients are unable to exit the building.
Heavy boulders from the hill-side construction are rolling down onto the residential colony every time it rains.
The roof of the local grocery market (mandi) is leaking so badly that the structural iron beams are rusting and bending.
Illegal storage of heavy marble slabs on the first floor of an old residential building is causing the floor to sag visibly.
The height clearance barrier at the railway crossing has been hit by a truck and is now dangling over the tracks.
A massive vertical crack has opened up in the main pillar of the heritage gateway near the city entrance; it is a collapse risk.
Unauthorized construction debris (malba) is blocking half the service road near the post office, making it impossible for cars to pass.
A new shop is being built on the common footpath area near the bank, completely blocking the pedestrian way.
The scaffolding for the building renovation near the chowk is very loose and keeps hitting passing buses in the wind.
Illegal kiosks have encroached upon the fire safety lane of the apartment complex, blocking any potential entry for fire engines.
The master plan for the colony showed a park, but a builder is now dumping bricks to start illegal construction in that open space.
The basement of the municipal office is always waterlogged because of poor drainage planning, making the whole building smell.
The house numbering in our new sector is completely haphazard and doesn't follow the sanctioned planning map.
A private wall has been built extending two feet into the public road near the temple, making the curve very narrow and dangerous.
Construction dust from the new commercial site is not being managed with screens, making the whole neighborhood unbreathable.
The public plaza tiles were laid poorly and are already sinking in several places, creating large puddles during the wash.
A lot of people have started illegal goat farming in a plot zoned only for residential use, causing a huge nuisance.
The zoning rules for silent zones are being ignored as a small factory has opened right next to the school building.
Rainwater from the new highway is being diverted directly into our low-lying colony because of a planning error in the drainage.
The local park is being used for unauthorized commercial parking at night, destroying the green area.
A cell tower is being operated with a loud diesel generator right next to the hospital, exceeding all noise planning norms.
The ramp for the disabled at the community hall is too steep and doesn't follow the universal design standards.
Our building was sanctioned for 3 floors but the neighbor is now constructing a 5th floor without any additional foundation support.
The signage for 'One Way' and 'No Parking' in the market doesn't match the approved traffic planning layout.
An old tree that is part of the city's green planning is being cut down illegally for a new showroom entrance.
The set-back area between two buildings in the market has been turned into a permanent storage for plastic scrap.
A construction company has left a huge iron mixer machine right in the middle of the sidewalk for over a month.
The public library's terrace is being used to dump old furniture, which is now catching fire because of the heat.
There is a massive dispute over the land boundary of the public park because the planning maps are not clear.
The temporary sheds for laborers near the metro site have no sanitation, and waste is being dumped on the planned service road.
A newly built commercial complex has no functional fire safety plan despite being fully occupied.
The underground utility ducts were not planned properly, and every time there's a wire fault, the whole new road is dug up.
A private garden has encroached into the space allocated for the sidewalk near the nursery.
The layout for the public parking at the station is so confusing that it causes a gridlock every single evening.
Authorized streetlights have been removed by a shopkeeper to put up a larger commercial hoarding.
The rain-water harvesting system in our society is non-functional and has become a mosquito breeding pit.
The outer wall of the municipal office near the library looks very shabby and needs a fresh coat of paint.
The tiles at the entrance of the administrative building are chipped and need simple replacement.
The information board about building bylaws at the colony gate is faded and hard to read.
A small section of the plaster on the community center wall has peeled off due to the last monsoon.
Requesting more clear signage for 'Gate No. 2' at the public plaza area.
The decorative plants near the planning department entrance are overgrown and blocking the window.
One of the glass panes in the hallway of the municipal school is cracked and needs a routine fix.
The 'Keep Silence' board inside the library study hall is slightly tilted and needs a screw.
Requesting a small display board showing the history of the heritage clock tower at the chowk.
The white wash on the pillars of the public seating area near the park is getting dirty.
Some old commercial posters are stuck on the pillar of the flyover and should be cleared.
The handle of the main door at the community hall is a bit loose and rattles.
Requesting better lighting for the name board of the 'Planning Section' inside the office.
The ceiling of the porch area at the station has some cobwebs that need a routine cleaning.
A small amount of sand from the nearby construction has gathered near the office gate after the wind.
The 'Building Sanctioned' board at the site near the bank has fallen down and is lying on the ground.
The plastic cover of the fire alarm button in the library hallway is slightly dusty.
Requesting a few more benches in the waiting area of the building permit office.
The color of the boundary wall in our sector is inconsistent; some parts are yellow and some are white.
One of the decorative lights on the municipal building facade is not working.
The carpet in the meeting room of the planning office has a small stain and needs cleaning.
Requesting an updated map of the 'Ward Area' to be put up on the public bulletin board.
The 'Mind Your Head' sticker near the low-height beam in the underpass is peeling off.
The metal gate of the park nursery is squeaking loudly whenever it's opened.
Requesting a small board showing 'Visitor Timings' at the entrance of the heritage building.
A bit of moss has grown on the stone steps of the public plaza near the fountain.
The 'No Entry' sign on the office hallway door is slightly tilted.
The information leaflet for building approvals is only available in black and white; please provide colored ones.
The plastic holder for application forms at the counter is cracked.
A small amount of silt has gathered near the drain of the basement parking after the wash.
